title: Partial victory for disabled rights, as some carers may board flights for free from 2027
lede: Under newly-agreed rules expected to come into force in 2027, airlines will decide whether or not companions to disabled passengers are deemed necessary for safety reasons. Only if their presence is required will their ticket be free, while companions traveling with disabled passengers anyway will have to pay for a full-price fare.

title: Farming ministers agree on more national control of EU funds as part of CAP reforms
lede: The bulk of EU agriculture subsidies are set to distributed via a new system of national and regional plans, as governments seize control of the bloc's subsidy scheme.
